subject: Front-of-house ops and staging walkthrough for Dec 14 exec workshop
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hilary Greene <h.greene@greenbridge.com>, Atlas AV Ops <ops@atlasav.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: Front-of-house ops and staging walkthrough for Dec 14 exec workshop

Hi Hilary / Atlas team,

We’re finalizing the staging and FOH plan for the Redwood exec workshop on Dec 14 (main room + 2 satellite breakouts). Can you confirm the following by EOD Friday so we can lock staging vendors and hardware?

Quick checklist:
- Stage riser dimensions and available riser sections (we need a 16x24’ riser, 18" height).
- Front-of-house position(s): recommended console location(s) for simultaneous hybrid stream + in-room AV control.
- Wireless capacity: expected concurrent device count, AP placement, and any recommended temporary APs.
- Video distribution: is there a failover/transcoder available onsite to simulcast to two satellite rooms + live stream?
- Cable/power: distro locations and estimated run lengths from stage to FOH and to the satellite rooms.
- Load-in windows and dock access (we plan to arrive 12/13 midday for load-in and a 12/14 early rehearsal).

Attached is the preliminary riser sketch and the AP coverage snapshot we used during the last walkthrough. If you prefer a quick site walk tomorrow, I can do 9–11am PT.

Also looping in Laura and Evelyn from our events team for capacity and guest flow feedback.

Thanks — looking to lock these ASAP to get the production quote.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Events Program Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: front_of_house_riser_v1.pdf]
From: Atlas AV Ops <ops@atlasav.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hilary Greene <h.greene@greenbridge.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Front-of-house ops and staging walkthrough for Dec 14 exec workshop

Hi Mina — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick responses inline: 

- Riser: We have modular 4'x4' risers that can be assembled to 16x24' at 18". We’ll bring two spare sections for contingency.
- FOH position: Recommended FOH is center rear, ~22’ from stage lip (good sightline and cable runs). We can provide a 24-channel digital console or supply a feed to your engineer’s desk.
- Wireless: Venue currently supports ~450 concurrent devices across main hall; for guaranteed coverage of 250 active Zoom participants + staff we suggest adding 2 temporary APs to the east aisle and one near FOH. We’ve attached an updated AP map and a short excel with recommended counts.
- Video distribution: We can provide an H.264 hardware transcoder with redundant encoder (hot spare) that can output three streams (main room, satellite A, satellite B) and an RTMP to your streaming endpoint.
- Cable/power: Power distro available backstage with 100’ snake runs to FOH. We’ll provide an estimated cable run list once we get final stage/load-in points.
- Load-in: Dock opens 12/13 10:00–18:00; overnight security is available. Rehearsal window on 12/14 07:00–09:30.

Attached: wireless_ap_count_and_locations.xlsx, sat_room_patchlist.csv.

If you want a walkthrough tomorrow at 10am PT, Ops lead Miguel can meet you on-site — confirm and we’ll put him on the calendar.

— Atlas AV Ops
[attachment: wireless_ap_count_and_locations.xlsx]
[attachment: sat_room_patchlist.csv]
From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Atlas AV Ops <ops@atlasav.com>, evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Front-of-house ops and staging walkthrough for Dec 14 exec workshop

Thanks — that looks good. A few additions from the events side: 

- Sightlines: Can we raise the riser front 6" (make front row easier to see for cameras)? If the modular risers support shims, that would help teleprompter sightlines.
- Stage left wing: reserve a minimum 6' clear path for talent flow to the greenroom.
- FOH staffing: plan for 2 AV techs at FOH during the event (one console, one stream ops). Evelyn, please confirm headcount for AV staff and security for load-in.
- Rehearsal run order: we’ll need a hard stop at 09:30 to prep hospitality and doors. Recommend a 08:00 tech check and 08:30 full run with presenters.

Mina: would you schedule the walkthrough with Miguel at 10am tomorrow? I’ll circulate the revised run order and a one-page AV matrix after the walkthrough.

Laura Bennett
Senior Events Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Atlas AV Ops <ops@atlasav.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com, Steven Kim <steven.kim@orchid-ventures.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Front-of-house ops and staging walkthrough for Dec 14 exec workshop

Thanks Miguel / Hilary / Laura — walkthrough confirmed for 10:00 am on 12/3 at Greenbridge lobby (I’ll meet onsite).

Prelim run-of-show / load-in plan (please comment):
- 12/13 12:00–18:00: AV load-in and rigging (Atlas lead Miguel).
- 12/13 16:00–18:00: FOH console setup and network smoke test.
- 12/14 07:00–08:00: Crew arrival and mic/line-check.
- 12/14 08:00–08:30: Tech check (camera, stream, PT).
- 12/14 08:30–09:30: Full run with presenters (hard stop 09:30).
- 12/14 10:00: Doors open for exec attendees; event 10:30–12:30.

Attachments I’ll circulate after the walkthrough: final riser diagram (PDF), final AP placement (XLSX), and a consolidated cable patch list (CSV). Steven (external) — heads up, we’ll route the RTMP to Orchid’s streaming endpoint; can you confirm firewall/ingest details by 12/7?

Mina
[attachment: front_of_house_riser_v1.pdf]
From: Hilary Greene <h.greene@greenbridge.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Atlas AV Ops <ops@atlasav.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Front-of-house ops and staging walkthrough for Dec 14 exec workshop

Hi Mina / Laura — great to meet you on-site. Quick recap and a couple of action items from the venue ops side: 

Recap:
- Riser: we can support a 16x24 at 18" with 6" shim at the front edge (Atlas to supply shims).
- Wireless: venue will provision two temporary APs as requested; Atlas to confirm exact AP model on Monday.
- Transcoder: Atlas confirmed redundant encoder and will pass test stream details by 12/7.
- Load-in & security: overnight security confirmed for 12/13; dock restrictions require vehicle check-in by 17:30.

Action items:
1) Atlas: send final cable run list and encoder test RTMP/credentials to Steven by 12/7.
2) Mina/Laura: finalize run-of-show and share with venue by 12/8.
3) Venue: provide final floor plan with emergency exit routing embedded (we’ll add to the welcome packet).

Pricing note: incremental APs and the redundant encoder are billable extras. Hilary will send an itemized addendum to the venue master contract by Monday.

Thanks — Hilary
Facility Operations Manager
Greenbridge Conference Center
